messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Alert triggered: embeddings-service error rate > 10% over 5m. Incident INC-2026-0123 created. Link: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2026-0123 — paging oncall-sanjay :phone: 

oncall-sanjay: Acked. Pulling logs now, will update in 2m. 

mira: Noted. CS prep: customers in billing and search teams may see degraded embeddings. Jess, can you start a hold message for inbound tickets? 

jess: Yep, drafting quick reply. Posting here for review. 

cs-bot: Suggested quick reply (Zendesk macro draft):
Subject: We’re investigating intermittent embedding errors
Body:
Hi {{customer.name}},

Thanks for the report — we’re currently investigating intermittent errors affecting embeddings requests. Our engineers have identified an active incident (INC-2026-0123) and are working on mitigation. We don’t believe data is impacted. We’ll follow up within 30 minutes with next steps.

Suggested triage steps for CS: 1) Collect request IDs + timestamps, 2) Ask customer to retry after 2–3 minutes, 3) If urgent, request a small sample payload for debugging.

Feel free to use macro: `embeddings_intermittent_incident_v1`

oncall-sanjay: Quick findings: error spikes correlate with heavy prefix caching invalidation (kv-cache evictions) after a batch job at 14:02 UTC. Rolling back that job is in progress. 

alex: Good catch. If rollback fails do we have fallback model route (cpu-embed-compact) we can route traffic to? 

oncall-sanjay: Yes — routing policy available. I'll open a canary route to cpu-embed-compact for low-priority traffic, keep high-priority on primary. 

mira: For customers: propose we publish a status page update with duration estimate 30–60m and a note about degraded embeddings (partial). Draft below, pls sign off. 

status-bot: Draft statuspage snippet: 

Title: Partial degradation of embeddings (INC-2026-0123)
Impact: A subset of customers may experience errors or increased latency for embeddings.
Scope: Affects embeddings API in us-west-2 and eu-west-1 for some model variants.
ETA: Investigating — estimate 30–60 minutes for mitigation.
Updates: We will post updates every 20 minutes or as new information becomes available.

mira: OK to post this version? Short and non-alarming. 

jess: LGTM. I'll queue the status update and apply the CS macro to active tickets. 

cs-bot: Intercom snippet for in-app banner (short): 
We’re investigating intermittent errors with embeddings. Some requests may fail or be slower than normal. More updates: https://status.redwood.ai/INC-2026-0123

oncall-sanjay: Mitigation step 1 complete: rolled back batch job at 14:10 UTC. Error rate dropping from 12% to 4% over last 3 minutes. Monitoring. 

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident update: rollback applied. Error rate trending down. Continue monitoring; oncall to validate. 

mira: Good. CS action items (short checklist for agents):
- Use macro `embeddings_intermittent_incident_v1` for ticket acknowledgement.
- If customer supplies full request ID, attach to incident thread.
- For high-severity customers: offer request queuing to route to dedicated capacity if available.
- Escalate to solutions-eng if customer needs immediate SLA workaround.

jess: Pasting macro text that agents can copy into Zendesk: 
```
Subject: Update: Embeddings issue (we’re on it)
Body:
Hi {{customer.first_name}},

We’re actively investigating an issue that may cause embeddings requests to fail or take longer than usual. Our engineers applied an emergency rollback and error rates have reduced. Please retry your request now; if you still see failures, reply with one example request ID and timestamp and we’ll prioritize.

Apologies for the interruption — we’ll follow up when the incident is resolved.
Thanks,
Redwood Support
```

oncall-sanjay: Confirming: error rate stable at ~2.5% last minute. I'll leave canary routing open for 10 more minutes, then shift back to normal. 

mira: Posting status page now (short update). Use this internal comm to execs before posting external: 
Internal exec blurb (for #exec-updates):
> Heads-up: Partial embedding degradation detected 14:02 UTC due to cache invalidation from scheduled batch job. Rollback applied; error rate decreasing. No data exposure suspected. We estimate full recovery within 30–45 minutes.

alex: Nice. Add note: CS is using macro `embeddings_intermittent_incident_v1` and triage checklist. 

status-bot: Status page published: https://status.redwood.ai/INC-2026-0123 — update ID 1. 

cs-bot: Recommended ticket priority mapping: 
- P1: Revenue-impacting / high-SLA customers — escalate to Solutions & oncall.
- P2: Degraded but functioning — CS macro + monitor.
- P3: Cosmetic / occasional errors — standard macro and wait for resolution.

jess: Added notes to active tickets and sent in-app Intercom banner. 

oncall-sanjay: Final: leaving handoff note for next oncall (mira will cover next 30m): 
Handoff: INC-2026-0123 — root cause: KV cache eviction after batch job; mitigation: rollback applied; canary routing to cpu-embed-compact; error rate now stable ~2–3%; monitor for 30m; if error rate climbs >6% re-open incident and escalate to runtime-eng. Logs: link to ephemeral stack logs attached in incident page. 

mira: Thanks — I'll monitor and update when resolved. Closing internal loop: CS team to wait for full recovery before sending final customer 'resolved' macro: `embeddings_incident_resolved_v1`. 

ops-bot: Incident note: status update posted, mitigation actions logged, monitoring until 14:50 UTC. If unchanged, escalate to runtime-eng. 

jess: Template for final resolved reply (for CS):
```
Subject: Resolved: Embeddings service issue
Body:
Hi {{customer.first_name}},

This is a follow-up to let you know the embeddings service issue has been resolved. The underlying cause was a cache invalidation triggered by a batch job; we rolled back the job and restored normal service. If you continue to experience issues please reply here with request IDs and timestamps.

We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience.

Best,
Redwood Support
```

oncall-sanjay: Marking incident as monitoring. Leaving channel but reachable via incident page. 

mira: Channel note: leave thread pinned to #support until final resolved macro sent. 

status-bot: Next automated update scheduled in 20 minutes.
